5af6f1f0f6.headline: GTA 6 Sends UK Games Retail Revenue Up 99% to £142m
5af6f1f0f6.full_caption:
GTA 6 has made a big mark on UK game sales. 🇬🇧

NielsenIQ reports that games retail revenue in the UK rose 99% to £142m during the launch period, and the headline credits GTA 6 for the jump. Revenue almost doubled, which shows how much pull a Leonida-sized release has on the high street.

The headline doesn't say exactly which dates or sales channels the figure covers, so we'll update when there's more detail.

Did you pick up GTA 6 at launch, and did you buy it physical or digital?

Source: GamesIndustry.biz

94555fdf20.headline: Hidden Capri Mission Can Net You a Unique Shotgun
94555fdf20.full_caption:
Got an unusual run-in with the cops in Capri? 🚔 There's a hidden encounter most players will have missed. Get arrested in the right way and you're taken to a mysterious facility, where escaping can earn you the CPD Moreland 850 shotgun. Swipe for the steps. Mild spoiler warning for this side encounter! Have you found it yet?

Source: VGC

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAutoVI #GTAVI #Leonida #Capri #GTA6Guide #GTA6Tips #RockstarGames #Gaming #HiddenSecrets
94555fdf20.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about a hidden Capri mission in GTA 6 that rewards a unique shotgun.

slides.title: Where to start
slides.text: Head to Capri in Mariana County, on the western side of the map. Go to the central plaza and look for police officers. Any officers will do; if they aren't there, walk around until you find some.

slides.title: How to trigger it
slides.text: Provoke an officer until they arrest you, cause a minor disturbance for a 1-2 star wanted level, or slap a cop while unarmed. Then surrender and don't break out of the arrest.

slides.title: Escape the cage
slides.text: You'll skip the usual Busted screen and wake up in a holding facility north of Capri. Attack an officer through the bars for the keys, or kick the cage open. Free the other prisoners and fight your way out.

slides.title: Claim the reward
slides.text: Before you leave, check the boot of the police vehicle outside. You'll find your confiscated gear and the CPD Moreland 850 shotgun, the main reward for this secret mission.

43c4c7908b.headline: How to Steal Andrew Node's Supercharged Truffade Thrax
43c4c7908b.full_caption:
Want the fastest car in GTA 6? 🚗 Andrew Node's supercharged Truffade Thrax is up for grabs, but you have to earn it. Scan ten No Flusher graffiti tags around Vice Beach, find a secret hideout, then raid a house on Starfish Island. Bring garage space and cash, because registering it isn't free. Have you grabbed it yet?

Source: PC Gamer

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GrandTheftAutoVI #ViceCity #Leonida #TruffadeThrax #GTA6Tips #GTA6Guide #RockstarGames #Gaming
43c4c7908b.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about how to steal Andrew Node's supercharged Truffade Thrax in GTA 6.

slides.title: Step 1: Scan the graffiti
slides.text: Find ten No Flusher tags, which look like little blue toilets, around Vice Beach in eastern Vice City. Scan each one with your WAiNK It app.

slides.title: Step 2: Find the hideout
slides.text: Once all ten are scanned, Cal's chat goes dark and a new message reveals a hideout near the tenth tag at Oldby Island. The evidence inside points to Andrew Node's house on Starfish Island.

slides.title: Step 3: Hit Starfish Island
slides.text: The island is a gated community with security, so go by boat. Dock at the jetty of the backwards-L-shaped house, then head round the left side to the white garage.

slides.title: Step 4: Know the cost
slides.text: Drive the car off the island and register it with Randy for 70k. You could sell it for 20k instead, but it's a unique car. Make sure you have garage space and cash first.

ead92669f5.headline: GTA 6 Black Friday: No US Discount, UK Gets a Price Cut
ead92669f5.full_caption:
Hunting for a Black Friday price on GTA 6? Here's the reality check. 🛒

GamesRadar+ found no US discount on the game itself. In the UK, Amazon has the boxed code at £64, and a PSN voucher at ShopTo is £10 off. Gear like controllers, headsets and chairs is seeing cuts, and the sales are expected to run through the weekend.

Did you grab GTA 6 at full price, or are you waiting for a deal?

Source: GamesRadar+

#GTA6 #GTAVI #Leonida #BlackFriday #GamingDeals #PS5 #Xbox #RockstarGames #CyberMonday #TheLeonidaDaily
ead92669f5.alt_text: Graphic with a Black Friday deals headline about GTA 6 pricing in the US and UK.

slides.title: No US discount on the game
slides.text: GamesRadar+ says GTA 6 isn't on offer at any big US retailer. Stock looks good except at Walmart and Target, and Xbox copies are available at the same price as PS5.

slides.title: UK shoppers get a small break
slides.text: Amazon UK has the boxed code down to £64. ShopTo has a £70 PSN voucher reduced to £60, a cheaper route to the digital version.

slides.title: Gear is where the deals are
slides.text: The writer flags discounts on the DualSense Edge in the UK and US, plus picks like the GameSir G7 Pro, Fractal Scape and Arctis Nova 7 Gen 2 headsets, and the Corsair TC500 Luxe chair.

slides.title: How long will deals last?
slides.text: Discounts started a week or two before Black Friday and should last through the weekend into Cyber Monday. Stock may run out sooner given the renewed interest in gaming.

ca81206193.headline: How to Steal the Bravado Banshee for Randy in GTA 6
ca81206193.full_caption:
Need the striped Banshee for Randy? Here's where to grab it. 🏎️

PC Gamer's guide points you to the Sunrise Premium Autos showroom at the north tip of Southside. No police lockup break-in is needed, unlike the Infernus. Swipe for the location, the key cloner step and tips to keep it in good shape for the condition bonus.

Have you got the Banshee yet, or are you still hunting?

Source: PC Gamer

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #GTAVI #ViceCity #Leonida #RockstarGames #GTA6Guide #GTA6Cars #BravadoBanshee #GamingTips
ca81206193.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about how to steal the Bravado Banshee for Randy in GTA 6, with a guide label.

slides.title: Where to find it
slides.text: Head to the Sunrise Premium Autos showroom at the north tip of Southside, northeast of Hamlet. It's southwest of Pay 'N' Spray - Salton and across the road from Ron Gas - Southside.

slides.title: Pick the right showroom
slides.text: There are two showrooms here. The other one holds Pfister Growlers, handy if you still owe Randy one. The Banshee is a convertible with a white stripe down the middle.

slides.title: Clone, then crash out
slides.text: Get in, use the key cloner and drive straight through the glass. Go fast: if the tracker beeps, speed up so it can't keep pinging your location to the cops.

slides.title: Repair and deliver
slides.text: Smashing the glass may dent it. Fix it at the nearby Ron Gas or the gas station near Randy's shop. A car in good nick earns a 5k condition bonus on delivery.

18fce6889f.headline: All 20 Kitty Litter Lab Locations in GTA 6, Plus the Balsero Code
18fce6889f.full_caption:
Hunting every Kitty Litter lab in Vice City? Here's your cheat sheet 🔍

VGC has mapped all 20 hidden drug labs and listed how to reach each entrance. The guide also gives the keypad code for the North Balsero Lockup and a quick method for destroying the equipment. Look for purple smoke, Spin On This laundry vans and purple cat graffiti to spot one.

How many labs have you found so far?

Source: VGC

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GrandTheftAutoVI #ViceCity #Leonida #RockstarGames #GTA6Guide #GTA6Tips #KittyLitter #GamingNews
18fce6889f.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about all 20 Kitty Litter lab locations and the North Balsero code in GTA 6.

slides.title: How to unlock the labs
slides.text: The Kitty Litter activity opens up once you progress through Chapter 3 of the story. After that, you're tasked with tracking down the drug labs around Vice City.

slides.title: How to spot a lab
slides.text: Watch for purple smoke coming from buildings, Spin On This laundry vans parked outside and purple cat graffiti. Any of these can mean a lab is close by.

slides.title: Where they are
slides.text: There are 20 mapped labs. Three sit outside Vice City, just right of the airport, and four are across the river to the west. The rest are spread across the city itself.

slides.title: Code and how to destroy them
slides.text: The North Balsero Lockup keypad code is 1999. To clear a lab, deal with the guards, then shoot or blow up the drug-making equipment. A grenade or sticky bomb can speed things up.

43847e1ca7.headline: GTA 6 Hidden Missions That Permanently Boost Your Stats
43847e1ca7.full_caption:
Want a bigger Health, Stamina or Focus bar in GTA 6? 💪 GamesRadar+ has tracked down six hidden missions that give permanent max stat boosts. Almost all of them give no hint until you finish, so exploring pays off. Swipe for where a few of them start, and no big spoilers here.

Which stat are you chasing first?

Source: GamesRadar+

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAutoVI #GTAVI #Leonida #RockstarGames #GTA6Tips #GTA6Guide #GamingNews #OpenWorld #VideoGameGuides
43847e1ca7.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about hidden GTA 6 missions that permanently boost Health, Stamina and Focus.

slides.title: Permanent boosts, no hints
slides.text: Some GTA 6 missions permanently raise your max Health, Stamina or Focus. You won't know there's a buff until you finish, and all but one are hidden, so you'll mostly find them by chance.

slides.title: Where some Stamina boosts start
slides.text: Scan the QR code in the Corsair Key bathroom to start Final Flush. The crop dusting poster outside the motel reception in chapter 2 leads to McKittrick Farm. There's also a trippy obstacle course at Lake Tallaloko.

slides.title: Focus and Health boosts
slides.text: Near the road construction site, a shooting challenge costs a $250 wager. Win it and you get $250 back plus a max Focus boost. For Health, check a Port Gellhorn garage around midnight when it's lit red.

slides.title: Don't forget meditation
slides.text: Meditation spots also raise max Focus, but GamesRadar+ covers them separately. Some of these missions take several steps, and you may have to wait before you can continue.

bf937fc0c7.headline: Rockstar North Boss Addresses GTA 6 Criminal Profiles
bf937fc0c7.full_caption:

The quote gives a first hint at how Rockstar sees the balance between new mechanics and the sandbox GTA fans know.

Are new systems like criminal profiles a welcome change, or do you prefer the classic way of playing? Tell us below.
